title: Ru-Ba-Ru: For Now & Forever
overview: Bangkok-based Tara Mishra and Nikhil Singh meet at a wedding ceremony and fall instantly in love with love with each other. Tara and Nikhil have been together for a long time, and Tara's ready to tie the knot. But workaholic Nikhil thinks their relationship is fine the way it is, believing he has no time for marriage. Bit by bit, their romance begins to unravel … until a little magic enters their lives.
